phase: development pilot; not confirmatory or manuscript evidence
authorization: 2026-10-29 user requested implementation and one small pilot for Figure A, archive-based previews for B/C, then formal experiments based on findings.
budget_basis: Conservative assistant-imposed ceiling for this explicitly requested small pilot, not reuse of any previous study authorization.

source.selection: Fixed before new pilot outcomes. Use only this source task's audited final SQL; no later-cutoff definitions, target solutions, test scores or target traces are loaded. Re-extract once and freeze for all arms.
source.historical_cost: Source exploration tokens are archived and reported separately from new API spending; source allocation per memory arm is divided over its two targets. New extraction is allocated only to definition/full arms. No-memory has no source setup charge.

goal: No method-dependent incumbent target. Identical fixed planner/validation/patience budgets and common prompt; all memory tools optional.
memory: Frozen source, no target writeback; program memory searchable across tasks sharing the entity. Definition compiler is the archived Rust implementation, accessed through a live source-only middleware. Target metadata caches start empty in separate cloned databases. Source compilation is not a certificate for target data; common target audit remains mandatory.
quality: Pilot validation only, no test-label access or test scoring. A qualified solution must pass the target audit and reach the paired no-memory validation AUC minus 0.01. Report score, validity, coverage, cost and adoption separately. This pilot cannot establish test non-inferiority.
failure: Retain failures, leaks, missing solutions and all incurred costs. Do not replace unsuccessful source or target with a better-looking run. Stop on unavailable source memory; preserve diagnostic evidence. No automatic paid reruns.
source_gate: Source SQL must pass a fresh temporal audit. Publication must admit at least one definition. Record frozen compiled SQL audits on both target populations before agents; do not filter definitions using target feedback.
figure_b_c: Read-only archival previews, with measurement batch and single-run limits explicit. Do not imply fixed-definition overlap sweeps or writer-rate scans already exist.
formal_gate: Freeze a new formal protocol only after the pilot, addressing provenance, source admission, temporal audit, complete paired support and confounds. Preserve all pilot outcomes.
